name: ccburn
description: ccburn's burn-up chart for your Claude Code session and weekly limits, in a pane inside Claude Code.

openOnStart.title: Open the chart at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the ccburn pane when a session starts. Claude Code only seats an unasked pane on a wide terminal; otherwise run /ccburn.

useCcburn.title: Share history with ccburn
useCcburn.description: When the ccburn CLI is installed, read its history (every session's readings, via `ccburn collect` in your status line) and add this session's readings to it.
